On the one hand, the drawbacks of implementing vehicle-free days are clear.Opponents of this policy often contend that restricting private vehicles causes considerable inconvenience for daily commuters
because public transport may not be able to meet everyone' s travel needs.
Consequently, this initiative may not represent the most

.Equally importantly the mismatch between the growing number of passengers and  the
ransport systems leads to  overcrowding in bus stations, metro and other public services. As a result, this issue gives rise to
among commuters and creates a negative commuting experience.
Additionally,people with disabilities, older adults and young children may struggle to use public transportation,
as it is not always accessible or convenient for their mobility needs.Nevertheless, these drawbacks can be effectively

On the other hand, I am convinced that the aforementioned drawbacks pale in significance when compared to the glaring benefits of implementing vehicle-free days .One prominent merit is that vehicle-free days can significantly reduce the amount of exhaust  emissions from private vehicles, which are a major contributor to air pollution and environmental degradation ,thereby improving  air quality.

Additionally,using public transport such as buses, metro over time enables people to recognise the benefits of this policy and encourage people to adopt an environmentally friendly lifestyle across society. It is widely recognised that it is prohibited for companies to reject job applicants based on their age in many countries. While this has admittedly certain benefits, I would argue that these are overshadowed by the drawbacks.
Proponents of this policy may argue that prohibiting age discrimination can
create job opportunities for older people
. This is due to the fact that the older workers
still possess considerable work experience, valuable skills, and a strong ability to work.
Meanwhile, those with a young age might be rejected due to employers’ assumption that they fail to obtain hands-on working experience and specialized skills.

Should companies be required to follow this policy in workplaces, it will give older workers a fairer chance of finding employment. Nevertheless, what this perspective overlooks is that completely banning companies from considering age in hiring decisions may create some difficulties
. The primary reason for this is that age can sometimes be relevant to a particular job. Some positions are more likely to require employees to meet certain age-related expectations
uch as physical fitness or the ability to work in fast-paced environments.
On the other hand, I am convinced that the aforementioned benefits pale in significance when compared to the glaring drawbacks. Indeed, p

rotecting older applicants may make it harder for young people to find jobs, as older workers may continue competing for the same positions as young applicants. This is particularly problematic for entry-level jobs, where young people are trying to enter the workforce

. Should companies have fewer vacancies available, young applicants may face stronger competition, thereby having fewer opportunities to gain their first job and valuable work experience. Furthermore, this policy could increase companies' labour costs, as older applicants often have more years of work experience, hence expectations of high salaries and better benefits. Allowing employers to consider age alongside other factors may give them greater flexibility when selecting candidates with different salary expectations. However, some people may dress in outfits that are not suitable for the workplace because everyone has different tastes. For example, some workers may choose to wear pyjamas, revealing clothes or gym suits, which can make other workers feel uncomfortable. Therefore, even if their work performance is not affected, allowing people to wear whatever they want can still have negative effects on their colleagues.

Ý chính của em ở đoạn này đang đi đúng hướng, nhưng em cần tập trung vào **counter-argument** hơn. Khi phản biện ý kiến “workers should be allowed to wear whatever they want as long as their work performance is not affected”, em cần chỉ ra lỗ hổng của lập luận này.


Cụ thể, em có thể lập luận rằng mỗi người có một gu ăn mặc khác nhau, nên một số người có thể chọn những trang phục không phù hợp với môi trường làm việc, chẳng hạn như pyjamas hoặc revealing clothes. Những trang phục này có thể khiến các đồng nghiệp khác cảm thấy uncomfortable, dù performance của người mặc không bị ảnh hưởng.


Các ý như “outfits can act as walking billboards”, “show professionalism”, hoặc bank staff/agency should follow a professional dress code là những ý tốt, nhưng nên để dành cho Body 2, nơi em giải thích những lợi ích của việc có dress code.
